recordings.prompt:
Summarize the important unread messages for you in one or two sentences.
Ignore newsletters and automated notifications.

Messages:
[3] carol: Standup moves to 10am tomorrow.
[4] ci-bot: Build #512 passed.
[5] newsletter: This week in ML: 10 papers you should read.
[7] alice: Please review the deployment checklist before Friday.
[8] ci-bot: Build #513 passed.

Reply with only a JSON object: {"summary": "...", "message_ids": [ids of the messages in the summary]}
recordings.reply: {"summary": "Standup moves to 10am tomorrow, and Alice asks you to review the deployment checklist before Friday.", "message_ids": [3, 7]}
